preconditions.description: Attacker must be any address (no special role required)
Attacker must hold at least some amount of the PocongNFT token to perform transfers

exploit_hint: The functions setMaxTxPercent() and setMaxWalletPercent() are missing the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any caller to set transaction and wallet limits to 1% (minimum allowed). First, call setMaxTxPercent(1) to reduce max transaction amount to 1% of total supply, then call setMaxWalletPercent(1) to reduce max wallet balance to 1% of total supply. This can disrupt normal token transfers and potentially be combined with other attacks to gain economic advantage.
